title: Spicy Algerian Chicken and Vegetable Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic North African-inspired dish, perfect for a cold evening. This tagine combines the richness of chicken and vegetables in a spicy and sweet sauce.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for another minute.
Add the chicken and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the carrots, bell pepper, and pigeon peas. Cook for 5 minutes.
Add the harissa, cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Transfer the tagine to the preheated oven and bake for 30-40 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
Serve over couscous or rice, if desired.
Let the tagine rest for 10 minutes before serving, allowing the flavors to meld together.
Serve with a dollop of yogurt or a sprinkle of sumac, if desired.
